title: Multimodal dataset from the CMx7-MM Experiment
description: This dataset comprises raw multimodal recordings from 30 healthy right-handed adults performing a hierarchy of cognitive, motor, and combined cognitive-motor tasks across three sessions. Data include EEG, fNIRS, ECG, EMG, torque/kinematic, behavioral (push-button), and subjective (sleepiness, cognitive load) measures, organized according to the BIDS standard. The dataset supports research into neurophysiological correlates of cognitive-motor interactions and dual-task performance.
methods_description: Each participant completed seven tasks (mental arithmetic, N-back, motor imagery, passive motor, active motor, N-back arithmetic, and a combined full task) across three sessions of approximately 30 minutes each. EEG was recorded with 32 channels using the 10-20 system, fNIRS with prefrontal and sensorimotor montages, ECG via Delsys Trigno, and torque/kinematic data via a Biodex chair. Auditory stimuli (digits and beeps) were delivered using MATLAB/Psychtoolbox. Subjective sleepiness and cognitive load were rated via the Karolinska Sleepiness Scale and Likert/visual analogue scales.
